_README: STALE ARTIFACT, kept as a format example only. This is an n=1 run of the v2 description, committed at 7e354d1 and never regenerated. It predates both the current description and the n=3 default, and it was produced by a harness version that wrote no 'rate' field. Its 8/10 recall and its two recorded misses were later shown to be sampling noise, so do NOT quote it as a measurement. Regenerating costs billed `claude -p` runs: `env -u CLAUDECODE python3 evals/measure_triggers.py`.
